summary: Russia launched multi-axis drone and missile strikes across Ukraine targeting Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, Kirovohrad, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Kherson, Donetsk, Zhytomyr, Rivne, and Chernihiv regions, while Ukrainian SBU struck oil infrastructure in Samara and Volgograd regions. A Ukrainian MiG-29 pilot from the 40th Tactical Aviation Brigade was killed, and Fire Point co-owner Denis Shtilerman survived an assassination near Kyiv. Ukraine's FP-7 tactical ballistic missile saw first combat use.
key_points: Russia launched Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones from Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Poltava, Cherkasy, and Dnipropetrovsk regions toward Kyiv, Rivne, Kirovohrad, and Poltava oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76021)
Captain Marat Mambetov, commander of 40th Tactical Aviation Brigade 'Ghosts of Kyiv', died after his MiG-29 was hit by enemy missile during a rocket-bomb strike. (Source: @UkraineNow/84422)
Ukrainian SBU and defense forces struck 4 oil facilities in Samara and Volgograd regions, including LVDS Samara, pump stations, and Volgograd NPP coking units. (Source: @UkraineNow/84438)
DLine data center in central Kyiv destroyed; Cosmonova and Parkovyi data centers previously ceased due to shelling. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33672)
Denis Shtilerman, co-owner of drone/missile manufacturer Fire Point, survived assassination near Kyiv; bodyguard killed, attackers killed. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33650)
Enemy plans to attack Lutsk with Geran-5 missiles and reactive Geran-4 drones within the week. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76016)
FP-7 Ukrainian tactical ballistic missile achieved first combat use; production planned. (Source: @UkraineNow/84423)
Kyiv bridges (Southern, Metro, Paton) closed causing transport collapse; explosions reported near Southern bridge. (Source: @tass_agency/398519)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted multi-axis drone and missile strikes across at least 10 Ukrainian oblasts targeting critical infrastructure, while Ukrainian forces struck Russian oil facilities in Samara and Volgograd regions. A Ukrainian MiG-29 pilot from the 40th Tactical Aviation Brigade was killed in action and Fire Point co-owner Denis Shtilerman survived an assassination near Kyiv. Ukraine's FP-7 tactical ballistic missile achieved first combat use, marking a significant escalation in Ukrainian strike capabilities.
ukraine: Captain Marat Mambetov, commander of a flight in the 40th Tactical Aviation Brigade 'Ghosts of Kyiv', was killed when his MiG-29 was struck by an enemy missile during a rocket-bomb mission; he ejected but did not survive. (Source: @UkraineNow/84422)

Denis Shtilerman, co-owner of Fire Point drone and missile manufacturer, survived an assassination attempt near Kyiv; his bodyguard was killed and attackers were eliminated. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33650)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting sustained multi-axis drone and missile strikes across at least 10 Ukrainian oblasts using Geran-5 ballistic missiles, Geran-4 reactive drones, and Shahed-type munitions, targeting critical infrastructure including data centers, oil refineries, transport bridges, and agricultural assets. The destruction of the DLine data center and prior loss of Cosmonova and Parkovyi facilities indicates a deliberate campaign against Kyiv's digital infrastructure. Ukrainian defense industry leadership is being specifically targeted, as evidenced by the assassination attempt on Fire Point co-owner Shtilaman. The FP-7 tactical ballistic missile's combat debut expands Ukraine's deep-strike capability. Enemy forces are preparing to escalate attacks on Lutsk with Geran-5 and Geran-4 systems within the week.
sections.regional_response: Poland's Foreign Minister Sikorski declared frozen Kremlin assets in Europe will remain permanently, potentially allocated for war reparations or Ukraine reconstruction. Zelensky declined certain powerful US munitions due to lack of delivery platforms. Ukraine's MFA, Defense Ministry, and Office are coordinating with partners on F-16 ammunition and air defense missile supply. Japan imposed sanctions on Russian defense entities including Voentorg, VNIIAR Progress, Alabuga entities, and Uralvagonzavod. NATO reconnaissance aircraft (Bombardier ARTEMIS II) have been observed twice in a week around Kaliningrad at over 10km altitude outside civilian corridors.
sections.intelligence_notes: MP Goncharenko publicly signaled Ukraine's willingness to negotiate neutrality, discuss NATO membership renunciation, sanctions lifting, Russian language/church issues, and Donbas status — indicating potential shift in diplomatic posture. Public opinion shows 51.7% of Ukrainians willing to make territorial concessions for peace per Active Group survey. Putin reiterated Russia never struck civilian infrastructure first and warned of unpredictable escalation moments including potential nuclear use. Russian diesel supply remains stable with only minor gasoline deficit; EU energy costs continue rising sharply (gas +140%, diesel +100%).
